title: Thermal factor.
officialText:
The value for the thermal factor, C , used in the calculation of ρ shall be determined from Table t f 1608.3.2. THERMAL FACTOR, C t
For SI: 1 h ft2 F/Btu = 0.176m2 K/W. ⋅ ⋅ ° ⋅

greenhouse shall also have a maintenance attendant on duty at all times or a temperature alarm system to provide warning in the event of a heating system failure.
